title: Tailoring subcategory dropdowns, local icon standardization, and anonymous worker registration UX fixes (frontend-only)

requirements.summary: Ensure Tailoring subcategories (Blouse Stitching, saree-related) appear under the correct Tailoring parent category in Registration and Search subcategory dropdowns, with safe fallback taxonomy.
acceptanceCriteria: In Worker Registration, selecting the relevant Tailoring parent category enables a Subcategory dropdown that includes "Blouse Stitching" and the saree-related subcategory option.
In Worker Search Results filters, selecting the relevant Tailoring parent category enables a Subcategory dropdown that includes "Blouse Stitching" and the saree-related subcategory option.
Backend getAllCategories() returns these Tailoring subcategories under the correct parent category mapping (not under an unrelated category).

file_operations.description: Extend frontend fallback taxonomy to include a Tailoring parent category with subcategories including "Blouse Stitching" and the saree-related option (e.g., "Saree Work" and/or "Saree Falls/Pico"), and ensure the hook continues to safely merge/dedupe backend taxonomy so these appear in dropdowns even if backend data is missing.

Ensure the Registration Subcategory dropdown is populated from taxonomy for Tailoring, and add a safe empty-state option/message when a selected category has zero subcategories (while keeping the dropdown disabled until a category is chosen).

Ensure the Search filters subcategory dropdown correctly reflects Tailoring subcategories from taxonomy, resets subcategory on category change, and handles Tailoring-related canonicalization without breaking URL-synced filters.

requirements.summary: Remove any frontend login/auth gating from Worker Registration submission flow while keeping Admin Panel behavior intact.
acceptanceCriteria: An anonymous user (not logged in) can submit the Worker Registration form successfully and receives the success confirmation state.
backend/main.mo:submitWorkerRegistration does not Runtime.trap for non-authenticated callers.
Admin-only endpoints (approve/reject/feature/verify, admin lists) remain restricted and still trap/deny for non-admins.

file_operations.description: Confirm the Worker Registration page does not prompt for Internet Identity login, does not rely on admin-only guards, and presents a user-friendly error if submission fails (without instructing the user to log in).
Verify Admin Panel protection remains unchanged and isolated to admin routes only (no shared guard logic inadvertently blocking public registration).

requirements.summary: Standardize category/subcategory icon rendering to local generated assets only, and ensure SafeIconImage uses a single local fallback SVG to prevent broken images.
acceptanceCriteria: All icons used on the Home page category grid and Local Skilled Workers subcategory grid load from frontend/public/assets/generated/* and render correctly.
SafeIconImage uses a local SVG fallback file (not a .png) that exists at the configured path.
No broken image placeholders appear when an icon is missing/invalid; the fallback icon renders instead.

file_operations.description: Add generated fallback SVG asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/icon-fallback.dim_128x128.svg and ensure it is the single shared fallback used across the app.
Add generated SVG asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/icon-construction.dim_128x128.svg for the Home page category grid.
Add generated SVG asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/icon-agriculture.dim_128x128.svg for the Home page category grid.
Add generated SVG asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/icon-home-services.dim_128x128.svg for the Home page category grid.
Add generated SVG asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/icon-transport.dim_128x128.svg for the Home page category grid.
Add generated SVG asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/icon-events-cooking.dim_128x128.svg for the Home page category grid.
Add generated SVG asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/icon-daily-helpers.dim_128x128.svg for the Home page category grid.
Add generated SVG asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/icon-repairs.dim_128x128.svg for the Home page category grid.
Add generated SVG asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/icon-supplies.dim_128x128.svg for the Home page category grid.
Add generated SVG asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/icon-blouse-designer.dim_128x128.svg for Tailoring subcategory icon usage.
Add generated SVG asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/icon-saree-falls-pico-worker.dim_128x128.svg for Tailoring subcategory icon usage.

Switch SafeIconImage default fallback from the .png to the local SVG at frontend/public/assets/generated/icon-fallback.dim_128x128.svg, and keep the existing onError swap behavior to prevent broken image placeholders.

Update the Home page category grid icon paths to use the local generated SVGs (frontend/public/assets/generated/icon-*.dim_128x128.svg) and ensure SafeIconImage fallbackSrc is also set to the SVG fallback asset.

Audit and standardize Local Skilled Workers subcategory icon paths so they reference local generated assets under frontend/public/assets/generated/* (no external URLs), and ensure Tailoring icons use the new SVGs (icon-blouse-designer.dim_128x128.svg, icon-saree-falls-pico-worker.dim_128x128.svg).

requirements.summary: Improve UX clarity for Worker Registration and Worker Search category/subcategory selection with clear placeholders, disabled states, and safe empty-state messaging (no new flows/routes).
acceptanceCriteria: When no category is selected, the subcategory dropdown is clearly disabled and shows an appropriate placeholder state.
If taxonomy data is missing or empty, the UI remains usable using safe fallbacks (no crashes) and communicates a clear next step to the user.
No new flows (booking/payment/chat) are introduced; existing navigation and routes remain intact.

file_operations.description: Refine category/subcategory selection UX: keep subcategory disabled until category selection, ensure placeholders are unambiguous, and add a safe empty-state message when taxonomy is unavailable/empty or a category has no subcategories.

Refine search filter UX: show a clearer placeholder when no category is selected (and keep subcategory disabled), handle missing/empty taxonomy without crashes, and provide a helpful empty-state message for users.

Strengthen safe fallback behavior messaging support by ensuring taxonomy always returns stable categories/subcategories structures (even when backend data is empty), so the UI can reliably render disabled/empty states without errors.
